title: An attacker can cause a denial of service by sending crafted HTTP queries to the internal webserver. (CVE-2026-123756)
description: CVE-2026-123756 is a medium severity vulnerability where an attacker can cause a denial of service (DoS) by sending specially crafted HTTP queries to an internal webserver. This internal webserver is not enabled by default and is protected by an access control list (ACL), limiting exposure.
